# Episode edits
## Context
[`updateEpisode()`](mex://method:2f849afa5c7f4ab0aab30fb68c4400e4) in server/store.mjs compares the supplied expectedVersion to the current version and records a new snapshot inside the transaction.
## Steps
1. Read the current episode and version.
2. Validate the proposed patch before mutation.
3. Supply expectedVersion; retain the returned version and history receipt.
## Gotchas
An omitted version check must not become an excuse for overwriting another editor's newer draft. A title is not an episode identity.
## Verify
Run npm test and inspect the stale-write rejection and history assertions.
## Debug
Re-read the current episode on a 409 response; reconcile intended edits deliberately.
## Update Scaffold
Update the route and grounding when version semantics change.
